verdict.rationale: Cognee is open source and can be fully self-hosted locally or via Docker with no account required, giving users complete control over where data physically resides — a strong implicit form of data residency control (cognee-docs-14, cognee-docs-23, cognee-docs-26). However, there is no explicit region-selection feature for Cognee Cloud (e.g., choosing US/EU data centers) nor any documentation of compliance/residency options for hosted users. missing for 10: explicit cloud region/residency selection UI or docs, compliance certifications (SOC2/GDPR data-location guarantees), any statement about where Cognee Cloud stores data by default.
